q4.testedSentence: Punctuation must not act as an operator, the `Searched:` line names the same plain words, and the word-matched records are the same; the order of meaning-only candidates may differ.
q4.sentenceSource: Parent ruling in embed-tests-brief.md; the parent owns the corresponding docs/failures.md correction.
checks: Both real CLI requests exit 0. A forwarding relate wrapper captures exactly text="why do we round half to even" from both calls, proving punctuation cannot reach the word index as syntax.
Both answers name why do we round half to even on the Searched line.
Both answers' word-matched ids equal the nonempty id set returned by the real read-only MCP word recipe for those plain words.
The complete fused order is not compared, since the raw punctuated request is independently embedded; existing Q18 verifies the raw request reaches the meaning search.
q4.observed: Both requests word-match only note-1. Full fused ids are note-1, ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003, note-2 for the punctuated request and note-1, ADR-0001, ADR-0003, ADR-0002, note-2 for plain words; only meaning-only order differs.

q25.test: Q25 build peak memory stays bounded as records grow from 8 to 128
q25.choice: Compare GNU time -v peak RSS for fresh real CLI builds of 8 and 128 synthetic public records, with the same maximum text length, and assert the stated 2 GB ceiling at both sizes. Each measurement has its own MemoryMax=6G/CPUQuota=400% systemd scope.
q25.reason: The brief caps tests at 300 records and forbids risking the shared host. A 16-fold growth in records exposes the old all-record tensor while staying fast and safely below the machine limit; thousands are unnecessary for that regression.
q25.fixture: Each record has the same short title and a statement repeating one public currency-rounding sentence 16 times. No private records, network access or model weights are committed.
q25.acceptance: Every measured build exits 0 and a real count(d) query confirms its full record count. Peak RSS must be below 2,000,000,000 bytes for each build; the 128-record build may grow at most 256 MiB over the 8-record build to allow allocator/runtime noise.
q25.limits: This is a bounded-size regression, not a fresh measurement of the documented 2,662-record run. GNU time reports maximum process RSS, the same measurement used by the ADR, rather than an aggregate cgroup-memory peak. It cannot prove asymptotic constancy for every input.

q26.test: Q26 stored vectors equal a fresh single-text embedding regardless of companion records
q26.oracle: A fresh independent process directly loads the cached real q8 model and embeds the public target's exact title/newline/statement in a one-element input. The oracle does not import src/embed.ts.
q26.checks: Read the target's actual persisted searchText/vector after three real builds: alone; with a short and a long unrelated companion; and with reordered companions plus an empty record. Assert the exact stored text, 384 dimensions, maximum absolute difference 0 and deep equality of every float to the fresh embedding.
